description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Red XIII)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Red XIII)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Earth Lower after using Earth abilities (max 1)

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Red XIII)], removes [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Red XIII)]
